name: uniform-heights
description: test.md 'Terrain edits made as the WE does': Set Uniform Doodad Heights (key Y, nothing asked) on five hay carts on rising ground, three on the ground (flags 2) and two with a height of their own (flags 6, 100 and 300) (make-uniform-heights.mjs). WE: all five box-selected in the Doodads brush, Y. Studio: Select All, w3.terrain.setUniformDoodadHeightsToMean. Every cart gets the selection's mean height and the fixed-height flag in both

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.selectAll'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.setUniformDoodadHeightsToMean'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); await w3.editors.saveAll();

name: uniform-heights-reopen
description: The same Studio edit, then the editor opens the map Studio saved and saves it again: the editor reads what Studio wrote (the doodads' heights and flags) and writes it back unchanged
